extra_details: The form ils is common in Louisiana French and throughout the French-speaking world. You may hear other forms for "they" depending on the speaker or region.
Eux-autres is one Louisiana French way to say "they." In southeast Louisiana, you may also hear eusse, especially in Terrebonne and Lafourche.
Eux-autres can also appear before "have" in the same regional pattern.
Ça can mean "that," and in some Louisiana French expressions it can also stand in for "they" when speaking generally.
